name: a preference that changed is remembered at its new value, under a task
description: The same category through the other read path: this probe carries a task, so the update has to survive hybrid retrieval and ranking as well as composition. It is the case ADR-0039 decision 11 exists for — a superseded record that still sat in the sidecar index would rank, take a slot in the top-k, and be dropped only at assembly. Verification against the valid window is what keeps a stale fact from costing a live one its place.
